name: automate-ui-playwright
description: Playwright UI automation with POM, selectors, and custom fixtures

scripts.metrics:history:
node -e "const data = require('./metrics/metrics-history.json'); if (!data.length) { console.log('
⚠️  Belum ada history. Jalankan npm run test:save dulu.
'); process.exit(0); } console.log('
📊 METRICS HISTORY SUMMARY
' + '='.repeat(60)); data.forEach((m, i) => console.log(`[${i + 1}] ${m.date} | Run: ${m.runId} | Pass: ${m.passRate}% | Time: ${m.execMin}min | Failed: ${m.failed}`)); console.log('='.repeat(60) + '
');"
scripts.report:latest: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'); const runs=fs.readdirSync('results/reports').filter(d=>d.startsWith('run_')).sort().reverse(); if(!runs.length){console.log('Belum ada run tersimpan.');process.exit(1);} const latest=p.join('results','reports',runs[0],'html'); require('child_process').execSync('npx playwright show-report '+latest,{stdio:'inherit'});"
